known_weaknesses: THIS STRATEGY IS ITS OWN PREDECESSOR. Its published path is identical to sec_signal_neighborhood_ensemble_v1/selected_path__50bps.csv in 165 of 188 weeks, differs by more than 1bp in 19 weeks, and totals 261.99% against that path's 259.99% -- about 0.08 points a year of a 42.74% CAGR. The sector-aware overlay, which is the entire premise of the strategy, contributes approximately nothing. Measured in Step 281.

It is therefore NOT a distinct sixth strategy on the dashboard, and neither is its 1.35x form. Counting them separately overstates how many independent things this project holds, which is the exact illusion Step 245 and Step 277 are about.
Its own result.json records all_falsification_checks_passed: false.
Inherits all of the above and multiplies drawdowns by 1.35. Leverage adds no breadth.
mutation_policy: Any change to the signal, universe, breadth, weighting, cadence, cost model or data treatment creates a new version and restarts any clock it carries.

what_this_file_is: A description of what the strategy IS, written so it can be rebuilt without reading the script that happened to produce it. A rebuild script says what was run; this says what the thing is. Step 278 found four of six dashboard strategies had neither.
